card.name: "and" after assess or evaluation
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "assess" or "evaluation" in warning instructions, just before a second action such as correct or treatment.

modes.label: Evaluation and treatment
modes.description: "and" after the noun "evaluation" in the NSAID GI-event warning.
modes.example: promptly initiate evaluation<< and>> treatment, and discontinue diclofen

modes.description: "and" after the verb "assess" before "correct" in monitoring instructions.

card.plain: It marks the "and" that follows "assess" or "evaluation" when a second step like correcting or treating comes next.
